description: This file defines a prompt management module with search functionality, including Prompt interface, SearchService object, and persistent store for prompts.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the search engines with builtin and user prompts.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a prompt by ID from the user engine.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a prompt to the user engine.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches prompts by text in both builtin and user prompts.
